decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster system is tightly aligned with our established coolant-management knowledge and service base, so our strong absorptive capacity makes continued refinement more likely than withdrawal.
Coolant nozzles are a highly related modular complement to our coolant systems, and the product line benefits from customer feedback and in-house engineering that support retention.

The scraper belt chip conveyor is close enough to our conveying and automation competences that we can learn from field use and improve it, though it remains slightly less central than core coolant products.
The magnetic belt chip conveyor builds directly on existing chip-handling and conveyor know-how, making it a well-absorbed portfolio extension that is more likely to be iterated than dropped.

The hinged belt chip conveyor fits our broader conveyor and automation offering, and as a large R&D-active machinery firm we would typically retain and optimize such a closely related variant rather than exit it quickly.
